text:
Maya: Quick pre-cut check — where are we on the train? what's left to cherry-pick? @sam @jen
Sam: Canary in eu-west and us-east is green. us-west failing perf on longest traces, investigating. No new cherrypicks in queue except raul's backport.
Raul: backport PR 482 needs a review for allocator fix. Kicked CI again, failing one flaky test (test_kv_cache_eviction).
Jen: I'm on reviews, will take PR 482 after lunch. Also flagged a config drift in infra: autoscale.min set to 0 in dedicated pools — can cause cold starts.
Nick: FYI deploy-bot pushed a canary for inference-runner v1.8.0 to 10% across east regions. Logs look normal so far.
deploy-bot: Canary completed: inference-runner v1.8.0 @ 10% (eu-west/us-east) — health: OK, errors: 0.3% (mostly timeout), latency p95 ~ 240ms
Sam: timeout spike looks correlated with longer-context prompt tests. Might be KV overflow on quantized path. Adding a diagnostic flag to the canary: --trace-kv
Maya: Can we delay the cut 30m if Raúl's backport isn't merged? Preference is keep the train if no regressions.
Jen: +1 to delay if backport touches allocator; otherwise proceed. Can we toggle fallback to v1.7.12 for affected routes? @nick
Nick: Yes, we have a rollout policy. I can set model-routing: fallback=v1.7.12 for /generate and /chat for the next hour.
Raul: thanks. I pushed a small fix to PR 482 — pinging @jen for review.
Sam: Also small FYI — QA reported one regression in reranker scoring thresholds. Not blocking cut but open for post-release patch.
Maya: Plan: wait 20–30m for PR review. If merged, proceed with cut at T+30. If not, delay and create hotfix train. Everyone ok?
Jen: ok
Nick: ok
Raul: on it
Sam: 👍
Maya: I'll update the release board and call the cut window at :20. If anything changes, shout here. Thanks
